sales_hooks: Microsoft committed $80B CapEx in FY2026, with Azure growth at +39% CC — the OpenAI relationship is the largest single HBM demand multiplier outside of NVIDIA's own supply chain.
Microsoft Maia 2 custom ASIC runs on Azure for inference; if it takes share from GPU workloads, HBM demand profile shifts from NVIDIA-intermediated to direct procurement.
Azure is the #1 cloud for OpenAI GPT-5 training — every GPT generation step-up requires a discrete cluster build, each representing hundreds of millions in HBM.
Microsoft's Copilot/M365 AI integration drives inference at consumer scale — the inference memory market (lower bandwidth, higher capacity) is a key growth vector for memory suppliers.

competitive_position.vs_aws: Ahead on enterprise AI (M365 Copilot); behind on raw cloud infrastructure market share
competitive_position.vs_google: Stronger enterprise penetration; Google stronger on search AI and consumer
competitive_position.hbm_sourcing: Primarily via NVIDIA (SK Hynix dominant); exploring direct procurement for future ASICs
